verdict.rationale: The client documents asynchronous submission: create_task returns a task id, results can be queried later with get_task/aget_task, and many jobs can be submitted for later retrieval. Kosmos runs complete autonomous research workflows, so long unattended jobs are supported. There is no evidence of any completion notification; the user must poll or block on run_tasks_until_done. missing for 10: documented completion notification (email/webhook/push), evidence of job duration or persistence limits, independent corroboration.
